dateline: Las Vegas, NV — ARIRANG World Tour Night 2 at Allegiant Stadium tonight; BTS at the 52nd American Music Awards tomorrow (May 25, MGM Grand Garden Arena)
heroHeadline: Day 4,728: ARIRANG World Tour Night 2 at Allegiant Stadium — AMA Appearance Tomorrow, Sphere Visuals Continue Through May 28
heroSubtitle: May 24, 2026 is Day 4,728 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Night 1 of BTS's four-night Las Vegas ARIRANG World Tour residency at Allegiant Stadium (65,000 capacity) sold out in a venue-record 23 minutes on May 23; Night 2 takes place tonight. J-Hope visited Urban Matcha in Las Vegas Chinatown on May 23, with videos of the visit going viral and triggering a sustained fan surge at Korean small businesses across the Las Vegas corridor. The Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere continues displaying BTS ARIRANG-themed visuals nightly through May 28 as part of 'BTS: The City Arirang' (Global The City 2.0). Tomorrow (May 25, Memorial Day), BTS appears at the 52nd American Music Awards at MGM Grand Garden Arena — their first US televised award show appearance in approximately four years. BTS holds three nominations: Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer ('SWIM'), and Best Male K-Pop Artist. On the charts, 'SWIM' holds its position in the Billboard Global 200 top 3 for a sixth consecutive week (K-pop record for sustained global singles chart presence), while ARIRANG continues in the Billboard 200 top 5 for its 9th consecutive week — the longest K-pop top-5 run in Billboard 200 history.
